headline: Apple, Steel Dynamics, CBRE Group And More: CNBC’s ‘Final Trades’
summary: Kevin Simpson chose Steel Dynamics as his final trade, supported by strong Q2 sales. Stephen Weiss recommended U.S. 10 Year Treasury, Joseph Terranova picked Apple ahead of earnings, and Bryn Talkington chose CBRE Group with better-than-expected earnings results.

headline: CBRE (CBRE) Advises On Senior Living Deal As Industrial Leases Get Bigger
summary: CBRE Group advised Clarion Partners on the acquisition of a senior living community, highlighting activity in the senior housing segment. The company is also reporting a trend of tenants committing to longer and larger industrial leases. These developments point to changing client preferences across senior housing and industrial real estate. CBRE Group, listed as NYSE:CBRE, is at a share price of $147.78, with the stock up 7.8% over the past week and 8.6% over the past month. Over longer...
